name: Procentive

lifecycle.notes: Sold by Ensora Health, the 2025 rebrand of Therapy Brands.

short_description: Ensora Health's behavioral health EHR for agencies: documentation, billing, state reporting, bed management and a client portal, sold on annual contracts.
long_description: Procentive is a behavioral health EHR sold by Ensora Health (the 2025 rebrand of Therapy Brands), alongside its TheraNest product for private practice. Ensora describes it as one system for clients, documentation, reporting and billing, with a reporting dashboard that flags revenue and compliance issues. The client portal handles self-service intake, scheduling, secure messaging, telehealth and bill pay. Ensora added a bed management module in 2022, and a customer case study from a nonprofit substance use provider cites e-prescribing with EPCS and state reporting. Procentive is ONC-certified; Ensora's certification disclosure notes an annual contractual commitment and possible one-time interface costs. Ensora's revenue cycle team offers a free billing health check. Pricing is not published.
one_liner: Ensora Health's billing-focused EHR for behavioral health and substance use agencies.
best_for: Behavioral health and substance use agencies that want billing and documentation in one system
Programs with residential beds, using the bed management module
Agencies that need state reporting and e-prescribing with EPCS
Organizations open to Ensora's outsourced revenue cycle services
not_for: Solo private-practice therapists (Ensora sells TheraNest for that market)
Practices that want month-to-month terms: Procentive is sold on annual contracts
Buyers who want published pricing before a demo
